market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trades around $78-79K on April 27, 2026 with bullish ETF inflows and institutional buying breakout above $74K resistance. For YES, BTC needs ~43% drawdown to $45K within ~8 months. Such a deep drawdown is uncommon when in an uptrend; base rate for ~40%+ multi-month drawdowns from local highs is low absent macro shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or crypto-specific event could trigger a deep drawdown over 8-month window
